deployed_from_non_canonical_source.description: Four live Edge Functions report an entrypoint_path outside the canonical Cockpit repository. Their deployed source came from untracked sibling working directories.
deployed_from_non_canonical_source.implication: Live behaviour of these four functions is not provably identical to the version tracked on main. Byte-level comparison is required before any stage depends on them.

sibling_working_directories.description: Nine parallel Cockpit copies exist beside the canonical repo. None is a git repository, so none has history, branch or remote. Work in them is unversioned and unbacked-up.
sibling_working_directories.note: Cockpit-stage5 contains 69 function directories but has no corresponding live deployment and no migration beyond 20260731000041. It may hold unreleased work.
